question: Should this draft, maintainer-labeled PR land with source-runner proof for the new skipped Gateway preview output, or should maintainers require packaged CLI rendering proof first?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but `doctor --fix` output is an operator-facing compatibility surface and the protected label/draft state intentionally requires human merge judgment.

options.title: Proceed After CI
options.body: Accept the bounded source-runner proof and land after exact-head CI and ordinary maintainer review are satisfied.

options.title: Require CLI Transcript
options.body: Ask for a packaged or dev `openclaw doctor --fix` transcript if exact stdout/stderr rendering must be proven before merge.

options.title: Hold For Downstream Stack
options.body: Keep this draft open until the downstream policy preview PRs are ready if maintainers want to settle the broader preview behavior together.

recommendation.title: Proceed After CI
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded source-runner proof and land after exact-head CI and ordinary maintainer review are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main runner and Gateway policy scope baseline are tied to vincentkoc's recent localization refactor, so this is the strongest routing signal for the output compatibility decision.
